summary: Castor Maritime Inc., a Cyprus-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K attaching unaudited interim consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic-reporting obligation under Rule 13a-16, signed by Chairman/CEO/CFO Petros Panagiotidis on September 14, 2026. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock are disclosed. No special-situation event is present; watch only ordinary shipping-cycle and liquidity disclosures, not deal arbitrage.
